providers.title: Uniform exclusion of Landau–Siegel zeros (OpenAI)
providers.scope: There is an absolute constant c > 0 such that every real zero beta in (0,1) of every primitive nonprincipal real Dirichlet L-function of conductor q >= 3 satisfies (1 - beta) log q >= c. Proved in the last lesson.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The logarithmic derivative of zeta
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The prime bias (OpenAI)
providers.scope: If beta is a real zero of L(s,chi), chi primitive real of conductor q, then the primes p <= X with chi(p) = 1 have sum of (log p)/p at most e(log q + delta (log X)^2/log q), delta = (1 - beta) log q.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Mass of the primes with chi(p) = -1
providers.scope: The primes H < p <= X, p not dividing 2q, with chi(p) = -1 have sum of (log p)/p at least log X - 4 log q - 3 delta (log X)^2/log q - log H - 2c_M.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Interpolation on a projected integer box (OpenAI)
providers.scope: If A: C^4 -> C^3 is surjective with kernel spanned by a vector with Q-linearly independent coordinates, polynomials with deg_{z_j} <= t_j take arbitrary values at the points An, n in {0,...,N-1}^4, once t_j >= 3(N-1) and prod (t_j - 3(N-1) + 1) > (4N-3)^4.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Rectangular boxes of exponents (OpenAI)
providers.scope: For 1 <= H <= N, the monomial rows with exponents alpha_1 <= 32 H^(2/3) N^(4/3) and alpha_2, alpha_3 <= 32 H^(-1/3) N^(4/3) span.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The weighted determinant
providers.scope: Rows chosen greedily by the weight alpha_1 + H alpha_2 + H alpha_3 give N^4 rows of weight at most 96 H^(2/3) N^(4/3) and a nonzero determinant in Z[sqrt d, sqrt 2].
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Exponent sums (OpenAI)
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The Frobenius congruence
providers.scope: theta^p = g_p(theta) mod p Z[sqrt d, sqrt 2] for odd p not dividing q, with g_p(sqrt d) = (d/p) sqrt d and g_p(sqrt 2) = (2/p) sqrt 2.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Divisibility at admissible primes (OpenAI)
providers.scope: For p > H, p not dividing 2q, chi(p) = -1, the determinant lies in p^(E_p) Z[sqrt d, sqrt 2], E_p = sum of floor(alpha_1/p).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A zero-free region without exception
providers.scope: For an absolute c_B > 0, no L(s,chi) with chi mod q vanishes in Re s >= 1 - c_B/log(q(|Im s| + 2)).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
